description: This file defines the 'ProductListActivity' class, which is an Android activity responsible for displaying a list of products in an online shopping app. It manages search, filters, category chips, grouped and paged views, interactions with the cart, and UI state updates. It also handles loading and error states, as well as preserving filters via presets.

classes.name: ProductListActivity
classes.description: Main activity for displaying product listings with filtering, grouping, and paging capabilities. Handles UI interactions, state management, and integrations with view models and repositories.

methods.name: setupCategoryChipsAndGrouping
methods.description: Initializes and manages category filter chips, observing category data and selection states to update the UI accordingly.

methods.name: toggleGroupedMode
methods.description: Switches between grouped category sections and paged list view based on selected category.

methods.name: renderCategoryChips
methods.description: Sets up the horizontal list of category chips for filtering products by category.

methods.name: rebuildGroupedSections
methods.description: Constructs the grouped category sections, inflating views and setting up lazy-loading of section previews.

methods.name: maybeLoadSectionIfVisible
methods.description: Determines if a category section is visible enough to load its preview, to optimize loading performance.

methods.name: loadSectionPreview
methods.description: Fetches and displays preview items for a category section when it becomes visible.

methods.name: setupRecyclerAnimations
methods.description: Configures item animations for the RecyclerView to make UI updates smooth.

methods.name: setupPresetsAndClearAll
methods.description: Sets up UI controls for saving, applying, deleting presets, and clearing filters.

methods.name: setupSearchAndFilters
methods.description: Configures search input and filter controls, syncing UI with view model state.

methods.name: syncFilterControlsToState
methods.description: Synchronizes UI controls to match the current filter state, ensuring consistency after preset applications.

methods.name: renderActiveFilterChips
methods.description: Displays chips representing active filters that can be individually removed to adjust filters.

methods.name: showSavePresetDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog allowing the user to save current filters as a preset.

methods.name: showPresetsDialog
methods.description: Shows a list of saved filter presets for the user to apply or delete.

methods.name: showPresetActionDialog
methods.description: Provides options to apply or delete a selected preset.

methods.name: confirmDeletePreset
methods.description: Confirms with the user before deleting a preset.

methods.name: updateEmptyStateText
methods.description: Updates the UI text indicating when no search results or filters match.
